task.title: Recover from product connection failure
task.shortdesc: Recover from a network, browser, or BPM API operation failure visible in Library or editor surfaces.

prereq.p: A visible BPM status, validation message, browser warning, or failed action indicates that the current workflow cannot safely continue.

context.p: Connection failures can be temporary browser testing caveats, network interruptions, server restarts, or API operation failures; the safe response is to preserve context before retrying.

step.cmd: Read the visible status and identify whether the failed operation was load, save, import, export, archive, restore, delete, validation, or comparison.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Check whether other BPM surfaces in the same browser session are still responsive before retrying the same action.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Retry the failed action once after preserving unsaved changes and profile context.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: If the browser testing caveat or API failure persists, stop user edits and keep the visible error details for maintainer review.

info.note: Do not edit internal storage, browser local data, database rows, or generated build artifacts to recover user-facing profile work.

result.p: The workflow either resumes after a clean retry or stops with enough visible context to diagnose the product connection problem.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the same error repeats after one clean retry, stop the workflow, preserve the visible message, profile name, schema channel, and current surface for maintainer review.
